name: Caprine
description: Caprine uses electron-updater for automatic checks when enabled; its Windows electron-builder configuration sets verifyUpdateCodeSignature to false, while this observation does not characterize verification for other targets.
limitations: This is a newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout.
